purpose: Deterministic ORIGINAL-v1 sampled movement-range plan for body/garment/floor evidence. This is model stress interpolation, not runtime exercise biomechanics.

sample_policy.limitation: Uniform finite sampling does not mathematically prove the unsampled intervals. Phase 9 still requires explicit review of peaks and any later runtime-specific continuous evidence.

interpolation.pose_bones: matrix_basis decomposition; linear location/scale plus quaternion slerp
interpolation.prohibited: No new pose definitions, no runtime exercise solver substitution, no gate or baseline changes.

contact_scope.equipment: not interpolated here; curl_handle and pullup_bar remain static endpoint evidence until an independently authored continuous equipment path/runtime harness exists
contact_scope.rule: Every sampled body/garment intersection set and floor penetration finding remains UNCLASSIFIED unless a source-bound classification row explicitly covers that sample. Classification never changes raw measurements.

deliberately_uncovered.reason: Only pushup_bottom is frozen in the current authoritative stress set. Interpolating from neutral would not represent a meaningful push-up range. Requires an independently authored compatible top/support endpoint or the real runtime path.
Static curl_handle and pullup_bar evidence exists, but the current stress script does not define source-bound continuous equipment transforms for interpolation.
